changelog:
Initial public release of the metrology-management skill.

- Supports structured metrology instrument ledger maintenance (add/update/query).
- Automatically calculates next calibration date based on last calibration date and cycle.
- Implements multi-level overdue warnings (red/orange/yellow/normal).
- Generates Markdown management ledger by default; supports Word/Excel export upon user confirmation.
- Provides compliance check, calibration planning, and clear role-based workflows.
summary: 面向计量管理员与实验室主管的计量器具台账与校准周期管理技能，自动计算下次校准日期、三级超期预警，并生成 MD 管理台账（默认）；可按需导出 Word / Excel 版本
